query: SELECT source_id, mh_gspspec, fem_gspspec, fem_gspspec_lower, fem_gspspec_upper, fem_gspspec_nlines, fem_gspspec_linescatter, flags_gspspec FROM gaiadr3.astrophysical_parameters WHERE fem_gspspec IS NOT NULL
scope: All non-null Gaia GSP-Spec Fe I/M source rows; no model, no label calibration, no FIT or feature claim
